description:
Test and correct PDF documents for accessibility.

axesPDF checks PDF documents against PDF/UA and WCAG accessibility requirements and includes tools for correcting problems.
New features
- axesPDF includes artificial intelligence (AI) functions. With these new features, axesPDF can now cover part of those Matterhorn Protocol checkpoints that previously required human judgment. You can find further information on this page.
- The "Checker" tab in axesPDF lets you individually select which check sets to run, including the potentially time-consuming contrast check.
Improvements
- Improved handling of XMP metadata.
- Improved handling of PDF compression streams.
Bug fixes
- Fixed an issue where saving a document with certain types of Optional Content produced an invalid PDF file.
- Several other bug fixes.
